name: Ward Anisotropic BRDF
aliases: anisotropic material standardized by Wald model
definition: An anisotropic material model that modifies the Beckmann distribution factor in the Cook-Torrance model to simulate surface roughness varying in x and y directions relative to tangent space.
summary: The Ward Anisotropic BRDF is a microfacet specular model that simulates direction-dependent surface roughness by decoupling tangent and bitangent axes via eigenvalue ratios.
